# PikTag

> PikTag is a contact app built on tags. Instead of filing people under a
> name you have to remember, you tag yourself with what actually describes
> you — #photographer, #accountant, #hiking, #ReactNative, #ENFP — and
> everyone you have met becomes searchable by need. "Who do I know that
> shoots weddings?" is a query PikTag can answer; a phone contact list
> cannot. Tagline: "Tag yourself. Find anyone."

PikTag is made by PikTag Inc. and ships free on iOS and Android. The
product is built for meeting people in person — conferences, meetups,
business-card exchanges — where you scan someone's QR code, both sides
get tagged, and the connection stays findable months later by what that
person does rather than by what they were called.

Two things distinguish it from a contacts app or a social network:

- **Tags are self-applied and searchable.** A tag is a claim a person
  makes about themselves, not a category someone else filed them under.
  Tags cover identity, skills, interests, social handles, meta
  attributes and relationships.
- **Tag matching crosses languages.** Tags that mean the same thing in
  different languages share one underlying concept, so a search for
  "photography" reaches a person who tagged themselves 攝影, and
  #ProductManager, #產品經理 and #プロダクトマネージャー resolve to the
  same set of people. The interface itself ships in 19 languages.

PikTag is not a job board, not a dating app, and not a public feed. There
is no timeline. The public web surface is deliberately small: a page per
person and a page per tag.

## Pages worth reading and citing

- [Homepage](https://pikt.ag/): what PikTag is, the feature set, and the
  App Store and Google Play links.
- [Full description for assistants](https://pikt.ag/llms-full.txt): the
  long version of this file — vocabulary, the questions PikTag answers,
  how tag pages and profile pages are structured, and what is and is not
  true of the product.
- [Sitemap](https://pikt.ag/sitemap.xml): every public profile and tag
  page that is fit to index. Test accounts, deactivated accounts and
  empty profiles are excluded.
- [Example profile page](https://pikt.ag/piktag): the official PikTag
  account, showing the shape of every profile page — name, handle,
  headline, bio, tags, and links.
- [Example tag page](https://pikt.ag/tag/Pickleball): the shape of every
  tag page — one tag, and the people who have applied it to themselves.

## URL patterns

- `https://pikt.ag/<username>` — one person's public profile.
- `https://pikt.ag/tag/<tagname>` — everyone who has publicly applied
  that tag, including people who applied its equivalent in another
  language. Tag names may be non-Latin; percent-encode them.
